name: Time overcurrent
summary: An overcurrent function with a documented time characteristic.
description: A time overcurrent function detects an overcurrent condition using the configured time characteristic. Depending on the device and application, the implementation can include inverse-time or definite-time behaviour. Its number does not specify a curve, pickup or delay.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Read the full function designation, including any phase or earth-fault suffix.
Use the protection settings and coordination documentation to interpret its operation.
drawingChecklist: Identify the applied time characteristic separately.
Link the relay and trip scheme.
distinction: Functions 50 and 51 describe different time behaviour. One multifunction relay can implement both without becoming two separate physical devices.
